subject: lm-35 ip validator: needs engine flag-parsing before relaxing (Chris false-credit catch)
description: Triage (linux-mastery-hint-validator-triage.md:48) wants `ip -br addr`/`ip -4 addr` to credit task 1. But engine LinuxTerminal.js:1023 does `ipSub = args[0]`, so `ip -br addr` -> args[0]='-br' -> prints "Usage: ip [addr|link|route|neigh]" (NOT address output, NOT lt-error). The agent's relaxed validator `args.includes('addr')` then credits that usage message = FALSE CREDIT (Chris BLOCK). Reverted to committed args[0]-gated validator (honest; the actual hint `ip addr` works verbatim). REAL FIX: extend engine `ip` case to skip leading option flags before the subcommand (e.g. `var sub = args.filter(a=>a[0]!=='-')[0] || 'addr'`) so `ip -br addr`/`ip -4 addr` produce real address output; THEN relax the lm-35 validator to first-non-flag ∈ {addr,address,a}.
